cards.ex: Let's pencil in a meeting for next Tuesday, but I'll confirm the time later.
cards.exUz: Keling, kelasi seshanbaga uchrashuv rejalashtiramiz, lekin vaqtini keyinroq tasdiqlayman.
cards.uzDef: Vaqtincha rejalashtirmoq, aniq sanasini keyinroq belgilash sharti bilan.

cards.ex: We still need to iron out a few details before we finalize the contract.
cards.exUz: Shartnomani yakunlashdan oldin biz hali bir nechta tafsilotlarni bartaraf etishimiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Rejalashtirish yoki amalga oshirishda muammolarni hal qilish.

cards.ex: Our vacation plans fell through because my passport expired.
cards.exUz: Mening pasportim muddati tugagani sababli ta'til rejalarimiz amalga oshmadi.
cards.uzDef: Reja yoki ish oxirigacha yetmasdan barbod bo'lish.

cards.ex: We can't rule out the possibility of further delays.
cards.exUz: Biz keyingi kechikishlar ehtimolini chiqarib tashlay olmaymiz.
cards.uzDef: Imkoniyat sifatida ko'rmaslik, e'tibordan soqit qilish.

cards.ex: Before making a decision, we need to explore all our options.
cards.exUz: Qaror qabul qilishdan oldin biz barcha variantlarimizni o'rganishimiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Turli xil imkoniyatlarni ko'rib chiqish, eng yaxshisini aniqlash maqsadida.

cards.ex: The bottom line is we need to cut costs.
cards.exUz: Yakuniy xulosa shuki, biz xarajatlarni qisqartirishimiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Muhokamaning eng muhim qismi yoki asosiy fakt.

cards.ex: I'm still weighing the pros and cons of taking the new job.
cards.exUz: Men hali ham yangi ishga kirishning foyda va zararlarini o'lchayapman.
cards.uzDef: Qaror qabul qilishdan oldin yaxshi va yomon tomonlarini baholash.

cards.ex: I'm at a crossroads in my career; I don't know what to do next.
cards.exUz: Men faoliyatim chorrahasidaman; keyin nima qilishni bilmayman.
cards.uzDef: Muhim qaror qabul qilinishi kerak bo'lgan vaziyatda.

cards.ex: A promotion might be on the cards if I keep performing well.
cards.exUz: Agar yaxshi ishlashda davom etsam, lavozim ko'tarilishi rejalarda bo'lishi mumkin.
cards.uzDef: Ehtimoliy bo'lgan yoki rejalashtirilgan narsa.

cards.ex: The merger is a done deal; the paperwork is all signed.
cards.exUz: Qo'shilish bitimi tuzildi; barcha hujjatlar imzolangan.
cards.uzDef: Yakunlangan va kelishilgan narsa.

cards.ex: I had a change of heart and decided not to move to another city.
cards.exUz: Men fikrimni o'zgartirdim va boshqa shaharga ko'chmaslikka qaror qildim.
cards.uzDef: Avvalgi fikrni o'zgartirish, boshqa qarorga kelish.

cards.ex: I'm starting to have second thoughts about buying that car.
cards.exUz: Men ushbu mashinani sotib olish haqida shubhalana boshladim.
cards.uzDef: Qilingan qarorning to'g'riligiga shubha qilmoq.

cards.ex: Don't jump to conclusions; let's hear what she has to say first.
cards.exUz: Xulosa qilishga shoshilmang; avval uning nima deyishini eshitaylik.
cards.uzDef: Faktlarni to'liq bilmasdan turib shoshilinch xulosaga kelmoq.

cards.ex: If you play your cards right, you could get a promotion.
cards.exUz: Agar to'g'ri harakat qilsangiz, lavozimga ko'tarilishingiz mumkin.
cards.uzDef: Vaziyatdan yaxshi natija olish uchun to'g'ri yo'l tutmoq.

cards.ex: We had to call an audible when the client changed their requirements.
cards.exUz: Mijoz talablarini o'zgartirganda biz rejani tezda o'zgartirishimiz kerak edi.
cards.uzDef: Kutilmagan vaziyat tufayli rejani tezda o'zgartirish.

cards.ex: After years of thinking about it, I finally decided to take the plunge and start my own business.
cards.exUz: Bu haqda yillar davomida o'ylab yurganimdan so'ng, nihoyat tavakkal qilib, o'z biznesimni boshlashga qaror qildim.
cards.uzDef: Qiyin yoki xavfli bo'lishi mumkin bo'lgan qarorni qabul qilish.

cards.ex: Starting a new business is always a leap of faith.
cards.exUz: Yangi biznesni boshlash har doim ishonch bilan qo'yilgan qadamdir.
cards.uzDef: Xavfli yoki noaniq vaziyatda ishonch bilan harakat qilish.

cards.ex: Our travel plans are still up in the air because of the pandemic.
cards.exUz: Pandemiya tufayli sayohat rejalarimiz hali noma'lum.
cards.uzDef: Hali hal qilinmagan yoki aniq bo'lmagan narsa.

cards.ex: As soon as I arrived at the party, I made a beeline for the food table.
cards.exUz: Bazmga yetib kelganim zahotiyoq, men to'g'ri ovqat stolidan joy oldim.
cards.uzDef: Biron narsaga to'g'ri, tez va aniq yo'nalishda harakatlanmoq.

cards.ex: Investing in education will pay off in the long run.
cards.exUz: Ta'limga sarmoya kiritish uzoq muddatda o'z samarasini beradi.
cards.uzDef: Kelajakda, uzoq vaqt o'tgandan keyin.

cards.ex: After years of struggling, they decided to call it quits and close the business.
cards.exUz: Yillar davomida kurashganlaridan so'ng, ular to'xtatishga qaror qilishdi va biznesni yopishdi.
cards.uzDef: Biron bir ishni to'xtatishga qaror qilmoq, ayniqsa muvaffaqiyatsizlikka uchraganidan keyin.

cards.ex: We're playing the waiting game to see if prices will drop.
cards.exUz: Narxlar pasayishini ko'rish uchun biz kutish taktikasini qo'llayapmiz.
cards.uzDef: Qaror qabul qilishdan oldin vaqtinchalik kutish.

cards.ex: I think I bit off more than I can chew when I volunteered to organize the entire event.
cards.exUz: Men butun tadbirni tashkil qilishga ko'ngilli bo'lganimda, o'ylashimcha imkoniyatimdan ko'p olganman.
cards.term: bite off more than you can chew
cards.uzDef: Bajarishga qodir bo'lganidan ko'proq ish yoki vazifani o'z zimmasiga olmoq.

cards.ex: They had to make a virtue of necessity when their funding was cut and they had to downsize.
cards.exUz: Moliyalashtirish qisqarganda va xodimlarni kamaytirishga majbur bo'lishganda, ular majburiyatni afzallikka aylantirishga harakat qilishdi.
cards.uzDef: Noqulay vaziyatda ijobiy tomonni topishga harakat qilish.

cards.ex: He burned his bridges with his former employer when he publicly criticized them.
cards.exUz: U sobiq ish beruvchisini omma oldida tanqid qilib, ular bilan aloqalarini buzdi.
cards.uzDef: Kelajakda qaytib bo'lmaydigan tarzda munosabatlarni buzish.

cards.ex: Before we move forward, let's take stock of where we are and what we need to do.
cards.exUz: Oldinga siljishdan oldin, keling, qayerdaligimizni va nima qilishimiz kerakligini baholaylik.
cards.uzDef: Vaziyatni baholab, kelajak uchun rejalar tuzish.

cards.ex: I'm applying to several universities to keep my options open.
cards.exUz: Men variantlarimni saqlab qolish uchun bir nechta universitetlarga ariza topshiryapman.
cards.uzDef: O'zingizni cheklamang, turli xil imkoniyatlarni ko'rib chiqishni davom ettiring.

cards.ex: They received the funding at the eleventh hour, just before the project was canceled.
cards.exUz: Loyiha bekor qilinishidan oldin ular oxirgi daqiqada moliyalashtirishni olishdi.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsa sodir bo'lishi uchun eng oxirgi imkoniyat paytida.

cards.ex: The deal fell through, so we're back to square one.
cards.exUz: Bitim amalga oshmadi, shuning uchun biz boshiga qaytdik.
cards.uzDef: Avvalgi urinish muvaffaqiyatsizlikka uchragandan so'ng, boshidan boshlash.

cards.ex: We have several new projects in the pipeline.
cards.exUz: Bizda bir nechta yangi loyihalar jarayonda.
cards.uzDef: Rivojlanayotgan yoki rejalashtirilgan narsa.
